theorems.name: Submission.lpf_wtc_wtt_blowup_integral_split
theorems.statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (M C : Set (Eucl Q)) (θ : Eucl Q → ℝ) (y : Eucl Q) (φ : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (Eucl Q) ℝ), NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) → NullMeasurableSet C (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) → C ⊆ M → (∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) (C ∩ closedBall y r) < ∞ ∧ IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ closedBall y r) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))) → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ∫ x in M, φ (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap y t x) * θ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) = θ y * ∫ x in C, φ (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap y t x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) + ∫ x in C, φ (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap y t x) * (θ x - θ y) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) + ∫ x in M \ C, φ (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap y t x) * θ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))
